name: Navbar
description: A navigation bar for your dashboards, drawn by Kiosk Satellite itself. It shows which page you are on and opens pages, menus and kiosk actions.
author: dimatx

settings.title: Position
settings.description: Top or bottom of the screen.

settings.title: Labels
settings.description: Text under the icons.

settings.title: Size
settings.description: Size of the bar and its menus.

settings.title: Opacity
settings.description: How much of the dashboard shows through.

settings.title: Collapsing
settings.description: Swipe the bar toward the edge to tuck it into a tab.

settings.title: Collapse after
settings.description: Tuck the bar away after this long without a tap. 0 never does.

settings.title: Hide on
settings.description: Optional. Pages without the bar, such as /profile.

settings.title: Label
settings.description: Leave empty to turn this item off.

settings.title: Icon
settings.description: Optional, such as mdi:home-outline.

settings.title: Selected icon
settings.description: Optional. Shown while this page is open.

settings.title: Target
settings.description: A page such as /lovelace/0, an action or a menu. The README lists them all.
